title: Before you start
intro: Kairo reads your inbox, groups each email into a ticket and keeps learning from what you confirm or correct.
points: Every email becomes a ticket with a category, a priority and a type.
Your corrections teach Kairo how your team works.
Kairo builds knowledge about your business from your support, so you do not have to write it.
